title: Admin Settings
summary: Provides per-object-type data source configuration for LarpingApp, allowing administrators to choose whether each entity type (ability, character, condition, effect, event, item, player, setting, skill, template) is stored in the internal Nextcloud database or in an OpenRegister instance.

title: Character Management
summary: Provides full CRUD lifecycle management for LARP characters, including player characters, NPCs, and other character types.

title: Dashboard
summary: The dashboard is the landing page of the LarpingApp, serving as the entry point when users navigate to the app.

title: Events and Players
summary: Manages LARP events (game gatherings with date ranges, locations, and participant tracking) and player profiles (real-world people who play characters).

title: Game Mechanics
summary: Game mechanics covers the interconnected system of Skills, Items, Conditions, Effects, and Abilities (stats) that form the LARP rule engine.

title: Object Service
summary: The ObjectService (lib/Service/ObjectService.php) is the central data access layer for LarpingApp.

title: PDF Character Sheet Export
summary: Enables game masters and players to export character data as downloadable PDF files.

title: RPG System
summary: Defines the core RPG mechanics of LarpingApp: Skills, Items, Conditions, Effects, and Abilities (stats).

title: Search Service
summary: Provides federated search capabilities inherited from the OpenCatalogi codebase.
